purpose: Descriptive cross-model comparison of controlled-field responses underlying the GPT/Claude collective reversal.

design.prompt_matching: Exact equality to the recorded GPT payload and SHA-256; same mirror-paired jittered offsets.
design.schedule: Retain each GPT block's frozen shuffled task order; acquire blocks sequentially.
design.seed_note: Anthropic does not receive sample_seed; retained only as a task bookkeeping field and for mock tests.

invalid_policy.parser: Frozen strict one-field social_action JSON, matching GPT controlled-field acquisition.
invalid_policy.macro_difference: The Claude macro runner also allowed deterministic rescue; this new acquisition uses strict parsing only and reports first-attempt missingness.
invalid_policy.retries: Same prompt/task, at most three dispatched attempts including interrupted/uncertain dispatches; no SDK-internal retries.
invalid_policy.retain: All attempts, raw text, timestamps, returned model, stop reason, token usage and error type.
invalid_policy.failure: Stop at exhausted/fatal attempts. Incomplete or failed-quality acquisition cannot enter primary analysis.

analysis.display: Show both blocks separately, a0, a1, R2 and full action distributions; display-only clipping of fitted mean action to [-1,1].
analysis.interpretation: No GPT-derived directional phenotype pass/fail hypotheses for Claude; no claim that a first-harmonic sign predicts closed-loop stability.
analysis.temporal_caveat: Acquisition date differs from historical GPT and Claude macro experiments, even with the same pinned Claude model identifier.
